items.text: Houston (Mon estimated report, short week): DNP - DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring), WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin), TE Brevin Jordan (foot/illness), RB Woody Marks (concussion). LIMITED - LB Jake Hummel (groin). FULL - RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell, OT Blake Fisher, G Wyatt Teller, C/G Keylan Rutledge, CB Kamari Lassiter, S Reed Blankenship. C.J. Stroud starts.
items.source: Houston Texans official Week 11 injury report (Nov 16)

items.text: Houston (Tue): Woody Marks ruled out for Thursday; Hunter and Harrison Jr. not expected to play; Al-Shaair set for groin surgery; Montgomery practicing and expected back.

Indianapolis (Mon estimated report): DNP - LT Bernhard Raimann (concussion), RT Jalen Travis (knee), CB Sauce Gardner (calf), CB Charvarius Ward (knee), DT Jerry Tillery (calf), LB Jaylon Carlies (neck), TE Will Mallory (hamstring), LS Luke Rhodes (hamstring). LIMITED - WR Anthony Gould (toe). IR - WR Alec Pierce. If both tackles and both starting CBs sit, the Colts side becomes the bigger cluster; check Wednesday's final report.
items.source: Houston Texans official Week 11 injury report (Nov 16)

items.text: Indianapolis QB: Shane Steichen says Daniel Jones (league-high 12 INTs) remains the starter for Thursday despite benching talk; not injured.
